title: Zero-Shot Time-Series Question Answering via Decoupled Perception and Reasoning

claim.summary: TSHarness decouples numerical perception from question answering: a Perceiver populates a tool-grounded Time-Series Perception State, an Answerer reasons over it and requests targeted re-perception, and a PPO-trained selector prunes tool calls, all built on one source benchmark and frozen for zero-shot transfer.

modules.name: Tool-grounded time series perception state
modules.scope_reason: The state stores valid temporal spans, statistical summaries and temporal primitives such as trend, dominant frequencies and changepoints copied from tool records with provenance, a task-agnostic temporal representation that would serve other task families without redesign.
evidence_locators: PDF p.4; passage beginning "The TPS defines a standardized"
PDF p.5; passage beginning "Evidence grounding. Within the core"

modules.name: Evidence-gap re-perception loop
modules.scope_reason: Checking required evidence against what the state covers, issuing validated targeted requests and stopping on sufficiency or budget is a domain-independent answer-evidence control loop.
evidence_locators: PDF p.2; passage beginning "The A NSWERER then reasons"
PDF p.5; passage beginning "Unsupported, duplicate, or out-of-budget requests"

modules.name: Cost-aware RL tool selector
modules.scope_reason: A small PPO-trained network shifts the LLM's proposed tool-inclusion probabilities to trade answer correctness against tool-call count, a domain-independent tool-use optimisation that leaves the LLM frozen.
